digest.component_or_area: CLI reference and distribution documentation generation
propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution checks must derive entirely from runtime registries and committed package help, eliminating regex parsing and hand-maintained command tables
All route-enumeration tests must use canonical registry methods rather than reconstructing command policy sets manually
A clean no-extras wheel must render approved help forms with exact committed bytes and no unintended import side effects
Full-extra contracts must resolve every lazy handler, parser, selector, and capability-to-extra mapping without executing command logic
Editorial prose and examples must be structurally separated from generated syntax and validated by deterministic lint rules
Repository-local commands for CLI generation checks and help rendering must execute identically in CI and local environments, including rebar-mcp smoke tests
